Author:     Daniel Darnell <daniel@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Fri Dec 20 17:04:56 2024 +0000

CommitDate: Fri Dec 20 17:04:56 2024 +0000

    Bug 1893603 - Publish nightly release Debian package to FTP. r=coreyb
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D232206

diff --git a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/manifests/thunderbird_candidates.yml b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/manifests/thunderbird_candidates.yml
index 1cf839aef77..a412554884a 100644
--- a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/manifests/thunderbird_candidates.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/manifests/thunderbird_candidates.yml
@@ -308,6 +308,17 @@ mapping:
         locale_prefix: 'multi/'
         pretty_name: Thunderbird Setup ${version}.msix
         checksums_path: ${path_platform}/multi/Thunderbird Setup ${version}.msix
+    target.deb:
+        <<: *default
+        description: "Debian package for Linux platforms"
+        all_locales: true
+        from:
+            - release-deb-repackage
+        only_for_platforms:
+            - linux-shippable
+            - linux64-shippable
+        pretty_name: thunderbird-${version}.deb
+        checksums_path: ${path_platform}/${locale}/thunderbird-${version}.deb
     target.complete.mar:
         <<: *default
         description: "Complete MAR to serve as updates"
diff --git a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/manifests/thunderbird_nightly.yml b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/manifests/thunderbird_nightly.yml
index 9ab4de8119a..c921ecc216e 100644
--- a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/manifests/thunderbird_nightly.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/manifests/thunderbird_nightly.yml
@@ -397,6 +397,26 @@ mapping:
             - ${year}/${month}/${upload_date}-${branch}
             - latest-${branch}
             - latest-${branch}-l10n
+    target.deb:
+        <<: *default
+        description: "Debian package for Linux platforms"
+        all_locales: true
+        from:
+            - release-deb-repackage
+        only_for_platforms:
+            - linux-shippable
+            - linux64-shippable
+        pretty_name: thunderbird-${version}.${locale}.${filename_platform}.deb
+        checksums_path: thunderbird-${version}.${locale}.${filename_platform}.deb
+        destinations:
+            by-locale:
+                en-US:
+                    - ${year}/${month}/${upload_date}-${branch}
+                    - latest-${branch}
+                    - latest-${branch}-l10n
+                default:
+                    - ${year}/${month}/${upload_date}-${branch}-l10n
+                    - latest-${branch}-l10n
     target.complete.mar:
         <<: *default
         description: "The main installer we ship our mobile products baked within"
title: Bug 1893603 - Publish nightly release Debian package to FTP. r=coreyb
